verdict.rationale: Muse's own VM stores everything it generates for you, including the tools and code it builds. You can inspect and edit those files, and the VM is continuously backed up so it can be restored, which is a coarse form of rollback. An activity log and audit trail let you review what Muse has done and plans to do. There is no documented versioning of individual automations or goals, and no per-automation rollback or change review. Missing for 10: explicit version history for automations/goals, per-automation diff or change review, granular rollback to a prior automation version, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Your VM data is backed up continuously so you can restore it if something goes wrong.
You can inspect, edit and download these files freely
Muse shows people a complete audit trail of everything it has done and plans to do.
Tapping on your Muse avatar will show you its full activity log as well as permissions you’ve approved.
